d:
Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary and Jan Suraaj founder Prashant Kishor were seen exchanging greetings and chatting at a memorial ceremony for former BJP leader RK Sinha in Patna. Their meeting sparked political speculation, but Kishor clarified that it was only a matter of social courtesy and that his political opposition to the Chief Minister would continue.
